translation.name: Dagger
profile: A dagger is a small weapon carried in Elaria by scouts, travelers, and people who do not want to burden themselves with large weapons. Its value lies in its light weight and easy storage. It may be an ordinary work knife adapted for defense or a personal possession bearing a family emblem. Its appearance and origins can tell the owner's story without changing its game values.

It suits a character who relies on agility and can serve as a backup when the main weapon is unavailable. Being easy to conceal does not make it automatically invisible during a search. In the story, it can help with ordinary tasks when the situation allows, but does not replace every specialist tool. A lost dagger bearing a recognizable emblem may provide a clue to its owner.

Attacks use Agility (AGI). The 1H designation means it uses one hand. The minimum is AGI4, and its catalog physical attack bonus (PATK) is +1. The price is 6 sp. A hero's total attack is then calculated from attributes and the applicable rules; the listed weapon bonus is not the entire final attack.
